model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for six different model configurations, including a baseline “Vanilla” model and several variants of “SepLLM” and “StrmLLM” with varying hyperparameters. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from 0 to 140,000 in linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 in linear scale, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The “Vanilla” model (purple solid line) begins near 3.35 and declines to approximately 2.52 by 140,000 iterations. “StrmLLM (n=64)” (blue solid line) starts near 3.3 and decreases to about 2.63. “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange solid line) begins near 3.28 and ends around 2.55. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green solid line) starts near 3.25 and ends near 2.54. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red solid line) begins near 3.2 and ends around 2.53. “SepLLM (n=128)” (dark blue solid line) starts near 3.3 and ends near 2.62. All lines exhibit a steep initial decline in loss followed by a slower, more gradual decrease, with most models converging to similar loss values by the final iteration.
